forward_looking_guidance.quote: Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year-on-year in constant currency terms.
Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
We expect effective tax rates for the FY27 to be in the range of 29% to 30%.

reported_actuals.quote: On Q4, our growth year-on-year was 4.1% in constant currency terms.
Sequentially, revenues declined 1.3% in constant currency due to seasonality and slower decision making in the month of March.
Q4 operating margins stood at 20.9%, down 0.3% sequentially, adjusted for the Labor Code impact in Q3.
We signed 19 large deals during the quarter with TCV of $3.2 bn.
Onsite mix further reduced to 22.8% from 23.1% in Q3.
Utilization, excluding trainees, was 83% in Q4 and 84.4% in FY26.
Reported EPS in INR terms grew 23.8% Y-o-Y in Q4 and 11% in FY26.
Free cash flow adjusted for the Labor Code and income tax refunds stood at $3.5 bn for FY and $882 mn for Q4.

reported_actuals.metric: adjusted free cash flow as a percentage of net profit
reported_actuals.quote: Adjusted free cash as a percentage of net profit continue to be well above 100% at 106% for FY26 and 111% for Q4.

reported_actuals.metric: yield on cash and investments balance
reported_actuals.quote: Q4 yield on cash and investments balance was at 6.2% and 6.7% for the year.
